select id, profile_id as profileId, material_type as materialType, status, legal_name as legalName, date_of_birth as dateOfBirth, material_name as materialName, material_url as materialUrl, scan_status as scanStatus, scan_message as scanMessage, scanned_at as scannedAt, review_note as reviewNote, submitted_by_user_id as submittedByUserId, submitted_at as submittedAt, reviewed_by_user_id as reviewedByUserId, reviewed_at as reviewedAt, rejection_reason as rejectionReason, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_profile_verification_materials where profile_id = #{profileId} order by submitted_at desc

select id, profile_id as profileId, hide_marital_status as hideMaritalStatus, hide_has_children as hideHasChildren, hide_children_plan as hideChildrenPlan, hide_accepts_long_distance as hideAcceptsLongDistance, hide_smoking as hideSmoking, hide_drinking as hideDrinking, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_profile_privacy_preferences where profile_id = #{profileId} limit 1

select id, user_id as userId, profile_id as profileId, relationship_to_profile as relationshipToProfile, permission, status, invited_by_user_id as invitedByUserId, accepted_at as acceptedAt, revoked_at as revokedAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_profile_ownerships where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'active' and profile_id = #{profileId} and status = 'active' limit 1

select p.gender, count(1) as cnt from cm_profiles p
group by p.gender order by p.gender

select p.city_code, count(1) as cnt, coalesce(( select lf.value from cm_profiles lp join cm_profile_localized_fields lf on lf.profile_id = lp.id where lp.city_code = p.city_code and lf.field_name = 'city' and lf.status = 'ready' and trim(lf.value) != '' order by case lf.locale when #{locale} then 0 when 'zh' then 1 when 'en' then 2 else 3 end limit 1 ), p.city_code) as city from cm_profiles p
group by p.city_code order by cnt desc

select p.education_code, count(1) as cnt, p.education_code as education from cm_profiles p
group by p.education_code order by p.education_code

select p.industry_code, count(1) as cnt, coalesce(( select lf.value from cm_profiles lp join cm_profile_localized_fields lf on lf.profile_id = lp.id where lp.industry_code = p.industry_code and lf.field_name = 'industry' and lf.status = 'ready' and trim(lf.value) != '' order by case lf.locale when #{locale} then 0 when 'zh' then 1 when 'en' then 2 else 3 end limit 1 ), p.industry_code) as industry from cm_profiles p
group by p.industry_code order by cnt desc

select distinct l.language_code from cm_profile_languages l join cm_profiles p on p.id = l.profile_id where p.profile_status in ('open', 'review') and p.archived_at is null
